### [ FLOW CONTROL ](https://www.dueker.de/flow-control/)
##  FORMSTÜCKE UND ARMATUREN.LÖSUNGEN REINSTEN WASSERS.
Armaturen, Formstücke, Verbindungstechnik und Service – das sind unsere Eckpfeiler für Flow Control im Tiefbau. Was diese Lösungen und Produkte auszeichnet? Sie werden mit größter Sorgfalt entwickelt, produziert, montiert, geprüft und gelagert. Aus duktilem Guss und hochwertig emailliert, suchen sie in Deutschland und weltweit ihresgleichen.
[Mehr erfahren](https://www.dueker.de/flow-control/)
### [ DRAINAGE ](https://www.dueker.de/abflussrohr-drainage/)
##  ABFLUSSTECHNIK FÜR DEN HOCHBAU.SEHR GERÄUSCHARM UND UNBRENNBAR.
Abflusstechnik von Düker – das ist ein Qualitätsfaktor für sich. Nicht einfach, weil diese Gussrohrsysteme langlebig und zuverlässig sind. Auch nicht nur deshalb, weil sie dank der leisen, geräuscharmen Entwässerung maßgeblich zur Steigerung des Wohnkomforts und damit allgemein der Lebensqualität in Gebäuden beitragen. Sie sind unbrennbar – und damit ein Garant für Sicherheit.

### [ WASTEWATER ](https://www.dueker.de/produkte/waste-water/)
##  ABWASSERTECHNIK.INNOVATIVE LÖSUNGEN RUND UM DEN ­GESAMTEN ABWASSER­KREISLAUF.
STRATE steht seit 75 Jahren für innovative und modernste Abwassertechnologie. Das Unternehmen entwickelt Abwasserpumpstationen mit dem patentierten Separator-System, Rückschlagklappen sowie Be- und Entlüftungsventile aller Größen. Im Industriebereich versorgt STRATE Gebläse- und Kompressoren Hersteller mit Rückschlagklappen und Anfahrentlastungsventilen für Luft und technische Gase. Der STRATE Service bietet ein umfangreiches Dienstleistungsangebot, von der Neumontage über die regelmäßige Wartung bis hin zur Sanierung, Ersatzteilvertrieb und der Rekonstruktion bestehender Anlagen.
[Mehr erfahren](https://www.dueker.de/produkte/waste-water/)
### [ KUNDENGUSS ](https://www.dueker.de/kundenguss/)
##  INDIVIDUELLE LÖSUNGEN AUF WUNSCH.FÜR DEN FALL DER FÄLLE.
Wir bei Düker bieten für Flow Control und Drainage ein breites Sortiment von Produkten und Produktgruppen in allen erforderlichen Dimensionen. Wenn Sie darüber hinaus eine individuelle Lösung aus Guss suchen – aus duktilem Guss, aus Grauguss, emailliert oder nicht – dann sprechen Sie uns an. ##  Stefan Flentge.Managing Director. 
Mein Name ist Stefan Flentge, ich bin Diplom-Ingenieur (FH) der Elektrotechnik und seit dem 01.01.2022 Leiter des Bereichs Innovation bei Düker.
Mit der DÜKADEMY laden wir Sie ein, sich mit Fachkolleginnen und -kollegen auszutauschen und sich so ein Netzwerk aufzubauen. Davon profitieren alle Teilnehmenden, denn Wissensaustausch ist der Schlüssel zu langfristigem und nachhaltigem Erfolg.
Wir möchten dazu beitragen, dass das kostbare Gut Trinkwasser effizient, schonend und mit Weitblick genutzt wird. In einer Welt, die von rasch voranschreitenden und zunehmend komplexen Prozessen geprägt ist, sind wir überzeugt, dass Zusammenarbeit und der Austausch von Informationen von zentraler Bedeutung sind. Aus diesem Grund streben wir mit der DÜKADEMY danach, nicht nur unsere eigene Erfahrung zu teilen, sondern auch ein gemeinschaftliches Netzwerk zu knüpfen. Über dieses Netzwerk bieten wir Ihnen eine Plattform, um Ihr Wissen und Ihre Erkenntnisse zu teilen. So gewährleisten Sie einen nachhaltigen Schutz der Ressource Trinkwasser und profitieren gleichzeitig von dem Wissen und den Erfahrungen anderer Teilnehmer.

#  DUEKER HISTORY. OVER 555 YEARS’ EXPERIENCE.
Our roots can be traced back to the year 1469. A lot has happened since then. And we have accomplished a lot to become who we are. And we haven’t stopped shaping the future. Here in Germany, in Europe – all over the world. You can find out about the most important milestones in our history here.
![](https://www.dueker.de/fileadmin/_processed_/6/b/csm_121A5626-1_sRGB_02141badda.jpg)
###  HISTORY 
##  THE DUEKER STORY.MILESTONES.
**1469**
First recorded mention of a mine near Laufach
**1525**
Mine, smelting works and iron mill in Laufach
**1840**
Manufacture of cast iron products begins
**1875**
Iron mill and blast furnace decommissioned: focus on foundry activities ever since
**1913**
Karlstadt plant established
**1918**
Friedrich Wilhelm Dueker arrives
**1923**
First enamelled castings
**1944**
Company renamed as Dueker
**1957**
First internally enamelled gate valve, new product on the market
**2004**
Change of owner to Klaus-Georg Hengstberger
**2010**
New hand-moulding shop and electric furnace built in Laufach
**2013**
100 years of the Karlstadt plant
**2014**
New cupola furnace in Karlstadt
**2017**
Spin-off of Düker Email Technologie (DET)
**2018**
Oliver Kraxner becomes Managing Director
**2019**
550th anniversary
**2020**
New strategy: Dueker becomes a solution provider for water supply and drainage
**2022**
Takeover of STRATE Technologie für Abwassertechnik GmbH / Establishment of a modern holding structure and new locations   

**2024**
555th anniversary

#  PRODUCTION: HOW CASTING WORKS.AND HOW WE DO IT.
We manufacture cast iron drainage technology for the Drainage division as well as valves and fittings for the Flow Control division. This starts with pattern construction and extends to the production of core boxes and small, medium and large series casting. The central elements of our facilities are the cupola furnace and the centrifugal casting plant using the hot moulding process with automatic casting equipment in Karlstadt as well as the electric furnaces in Laufach. We also specialise in coating and enamelling in the field of surface protection. We are very flexible in everything that we do – to meet your needs.

###  QUALITY 
##  CASTING IN PRODUCTIONWHAT’S IMPORTANT TO US.
Dueker is certified according to ISO 9001. Our process and production monitoring is carried out in coordination with the DVGW (German Association for Gas and Water Applications), the EADIPS® (European Association for Ductile Iron Pipe Systems) and the GEG (Quality Association for Cast Iron Drainage Technology). This gives you, our customers, the assurance that we always meet high product quality requirements, especially in very sensitive areas of application. 
We set standards in all process steps – in development, production and service. Dueker products stand out due to their long service life and incorporate state-of-the-art technology. They are always manufactured in reproducible process steps – in accordance with regularly monitored quality standards.
Our quality management involves continuous training of our employees. We test delivered raw materials and carry out spectral analyses of the materials. We also subject our products to physical inspections such as tensile tests according to ISO 6892-1, impact tests according to ISO 148-1 and Brinell hardness tests according to ISO 6506-1. Furthermore, we ensure the quality of our solutions using metallographic examinations and ultrasonic testing as well as core and moulding sand tests. Component geometry and dimensional accuracy are subject to constant monitoring using modern 3D measuring technology. Just like all ongoing processes. This is precisely what makes our solutions premium solutions.

###  MATERIALS 
##  GREY CAST IRON AND DUCTILE CAST IRON.IN A MULTITUDE OF GRADES.
Dueker has unique expertise in cast iron. Cast iron combines excellent properties such as tightness, no maintenance requirements and a long service life, making it perfect for applications in water supply and disposal. And most importantly, our cast iron products are incredibly sustainable. They are made one hundred percent from scrap iron. And once they have done their job, they can be reprocessed to create new products.
On the one hand, Dueker specialises in grey cast iron with finely distributed lamellar graphite (EN-GJL-150 to 300), which is used in the Drainage division. On the other hand, in the Flow Control division, we specialise in ductile cast iron – i.e. the processing of malleable cast iron in various grades (EN-GJS-400-15; EN-GJS-400-18; EN-GJS-500-7; EN-GJS-600-3; EN-GJS-700-2).
We also supply silicon castings upon request. Please do not hesitate to contact us.
###  SURFACE PROTECTION 
##  COATING AND ENAMEL.WE ARE MASTERS OF THIS. 
The demands on water supply and disposal have always been exceptionally high – and this remains the case. Corrosion is still the main cause of pipeline damage. Effective and durable surface protection is required to cope with any situation. We can provide this.
We have mastered a wide range of adapted and application-oriented linings made of cement mortar, epoxy powder coatings, various special coatings and, most importantly, enamels. Enamel is the best, long-term surface protection against corrosion and guarantees maximum hygiene.
We have been specialising in enamel since 1918 when Friedrich Wilhelm Dueker, who we are now named after, brought his expertise to the company. Consisting of natural raw materials such as quartz, feldspar, borax, soda and metal oxides, this special glass forms a chemical bond with the substrate during enamelling. This is precisely why enamel has such a unique effect in terms of corrosion resistance, impact resistance, resistance to incrustation and acids, deposits of bacteria, wear and abrasion.

#  DUEKER VISION AND VALUES.WHAT WE STAND FOR AND HOW WE ACT.
At Dueker, we supply our customers and partners in the planning, construction and operations sector with sustainable premium solutions, high-quality products and individual service.
![](https://www.dueker.de/fileadmin/_processed_/5/8/csm_121A6906-1_sRGB_3de59ed331.jpg)
###  POSITIONING 
##  DUEKER VISION.WHAT WE STAND FOR.
Dueker is a leading provider of sustainable, high-quality products and services for water supply and disposal. .
The quality of our durable, sustainable, premium products with “best-in-class” hygienic and corrosion-resistant coatings will be actively placed at the forefront of everything that we do from now on. 
###  CORE VALUES 
##  DUEKER CORE VALUES. THE COMPASS OF OUR BUSINESS.
###  CORE VALUES 
##  WE DELIVER RESULTS.BECAUSE WE’RE GOOD AT WHAT WE DO – REALLY GOOD.
Delivering premium solutions on an international scale, especially for a commodity as precious as water – this requires a pronounced awareness of quality as well as determination, efficiency and coordinated action in the interests of the issue, the customer and, not least, the company. Because at the end of the day, the result has to work for everyone.
###  CORE VALUES 
##  WATER IS OUR ELEMENT.IT’S IN THE BEST OF HANDS WITH US.
There is no better guarantee of a hygienic water supply than enamelled fittings and valves. Full enamelling is one of our core areas of expertise. The cleanness of our flow control solution is matched by the safety of our fireproof, highly soundproofed building drainage solution.
###  CORE VALUES 
##  WE PROVIDE PREMIUM SOLUTIONS.DURABLE. SUSTAINABLE. ENVIRONMENTALLY SOUND.
Cast iron lasts for many hundreds of years. That makes cast iron one of the most sustainable solutions for water supply and disposal. We rely on it at Dueker, in flow control and drainage. But that’s not all. We are keen to provide you with a sustainable premium solution that works for many years, is environmentally sound and meets your expectations.
###  CORE VALUES 
##  WE SHAPE THE FUTURE.FORWARD-LOOKING, LONG-TERM, APPROPRIATE.
With 555 years’ experience, we at Dueker are ideally equipped for the future. We have real staying power and forward-looking solutions.
###  CORE VALUES 
##  CUSTOMERS ARE AT THE HEART OF EVERYTHING WE DO.WE ARE PROUD TO PLAY A PART IN YOUR SUCCESS.
Whether you are a waterworks operator, a planner or an engineer, a building contractor or an investor, a processor or a retailer – as a customer, you will be given priority at Dueker. We are close at hand to deal with any questions about your project. Because we understand our business – and yours.
###  CORE VALUES 
##  WE OPERATE GLOBALLY.BECAUSE WATER KNOWS NO BOUNDARIES.
Water is needed and consumed everywhere. We are committed to delivering the best components for water supply and disposal. Wherever you need our premium solutions, we will come to you. That’s a promise.
###  CORE VALUES 
##  WE HAVE A COLLABORATIVE APPROACH.OUR AIM IS THAT EVERYONE ENDS UP WINNING.
Here at Dueker, we are solution providers for enamelling, flow control and drainage. But above all, we are a partner for our customers. Whenever you need us, we are on hand with outstanding advice and reliable service.
###  CORE VALUES 
##  WE ARE AN SME “MADE IN GERMANY”.FLEXIBLE. RELIABLE. FAST.
As an SME, here at Dueker, we are aware of our special responsibility to our customers, our employees and the people in the region. We are committed to trust and reliability. Take our word for it.
###  CORE VALUES 
##  WE ARE OPEN TO NEW THINGS.BECAUSE WE RECOGNISE OPPORTUNITIES IN CHANGES.
Only those who change keep pace with the times. That applies to us at Dueker, too. We are always flexible, as flexibility defines our success. You can rely on us, because our solutions are made with the future in mind.
